সব মডিউল ও বিল্ড প্রিভিউ

বাস্তব signed staging, ব্যবহারযোগ্য isolated preview এবং এখনও UI সংযোগ বাকি—আলাদা করে দেখানো হচ্ছে। এই তালিকা ২৬ নভেম্বর ২০২৬-এর যাচাইকৃত build snapshot; production certification নয়।

*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f5f7f6;color:#172a2b;font:15px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif}header{padding:24px clamp(16px,4vw,48px);background:#163f43;color:#fff}header a{color:#d5f4ed}header h1{font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,36px);margin:6px 0}header p{max-width:950px;margin:6px 0}.eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#b8ddd5}main{max-width:1400px;margin:auto;padding:18px clamp(12px,3vw,36px)}.metrics,.cards{display:grid;gap:12px}.metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.metrics div{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d2dfda;border-radius:12px;padding:12px}.metrics strong{display:block;font-size:27px;color:#174c4c}.metrics span{font-size:12px}.notice{border-left:4px solid #ba861c;padding:10px 14px;background:#fff6dc}.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(245px,1fr))}.cards article{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;gap:7px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d2dfda;border-radius:12px;padding:16px}.tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.4px;color:#405e59}.signed .tag{color:#116147}.preview .tag{color:#955a04}.pending .tag{color:#60666b}.cards h2{font-size:19px;margin:0}.cards p{margin:0 0 8px;flex:1;color:#435657}.cards a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:7px 12px;background:#174c4c;color:white;text-decoration:none;border-radius:8px;font-weight:650}.preview a{background:#765415}.notopen{font-size:12px;color:#687576}.industries{margin-top:24px;background:white;padding:16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #d2dfda}.industries h2{margin:0;font-size:20px}@media(max-width:600px){.metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}}a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #df9c26;outline-offset:3px}
